product.name: WebWindows
product.company: 成都亚原软件有限公司
product.positioningBoundary: A modular browser desktop and application platform; not yet a complete replacement for a host operating system.

capabilities: application catalog, lifecycle and file associations
cloud files, search and resource opening
Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese and English localization
Developer Studio, manifests, permissions, preview sandbox and capability broker
DeskTalk, mailbox integration and server-proxied AI
Wendao navigation, Chinese railway and scoped overseas transit
versioned FTP deployment manifest, backup and integrity gates
candidateSegmentsToValidate: branded cloud workspace for SMEs and trade teams
desktop packaging platform for web application developers
factsNotToOverclaim: No customer, revenue, retention or market-share data is provided.
Real host device control requires a trusted native shell.
Shinkansen and global long-distance schedules lack a confirmed long-term reliable data license.
The Rome2Rio provider is a disabled integration slot, not an available production feature.
Running train positions are primarily schedule and route estimates, not guaranteed real-time GPS.
Some production database and security rollout work remains manual or pending.
majorRisks: product scope is too broad for an early team
third-party data and API licensing can dominate cost and reliability
FTP and IIS production operations still include manual steps
market demand and willingness to pay remain unvalidated
recommendedAnalysisLens: Find the smallest sellable product slice and validate paying users before expanding the general-purpose Web OS vision.
